cypher: MATCH (c:Consumer) RETURN c.category AS category, count(c) AS consumers ORDER BY consumers DESC LIMIT 100

MATCH (s:Substation)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(r:Region {name: 'Рівненська область'}) RETURN s.id AS substation, s.name AS name, s.currentLoad AS currentLoad, s.nominalCapacity AS nominalCapacity, round(100.0 * s.currentLoad / s.nominalCapacity, 2) AS loadPercent ORDER BY loadPercent DESC LIMIT 100

MATCH (c:Consumer)-[:HAS_METER]->(m:Meter {status: 'несправний'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:CONNECTED_TO]->(s:Substation) RETURN m.id AS meter, c.id AS consumer, c.name AS consumerName, s.id AS substation, s.name AS substationName LIMIT 100
MATCH (fm:ForecastModel)-[:GENERATED]->(f:Forecast) RETURN fm.id AS model, fm.name AS name, fm.modelType AS modelType, count(f) AS forecasts ORDER BY forecasts DESC LIMIT 1

MATCH (d:Dispatcher {id: 'Dispatcher_5'})-[:USES_FORECAST]->(f:Forecast) OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:FORECAST_FOR]->(s:Substation) RETURN f.id AS forecast, f.name AS forecastName, f.forecastPeriod AS period, s.id AS substation, s.name AS substationName LIMIT 100
MATCH (src:Substation {id: 'Substation_1'})-[:FEEDS*1..]->(s:Substation) WHERE s <> src RETURN DISTINCT s.id AS substation, s.name AS name LIMIT 100
MATCH (fm:ForecastModel)-[:GENERATED]->(f:Forecast) RETURN fm.modelType AS modelType, avg(f.errorPercentage) AS avgErrorPercentage, count(f) AS forecasts ORDER BY avgErrorPercentage LIMIT 100

MATCH (c:Consumer)-[:CONNECTED_TO]->(s:Substation) WHERE s.nominalCapacity > 0 AND s.currentLoad >= 0.85 * s.nominalCapacity RETURN c.id AS consumer, c.name AS consumerName, c.category AS category, s.id AS substation, round(100.0 * s.currentLoad / s.nominalCapacity, 2) AS loadPercent ORDER BY loadPercent DESC LIMIT 100

MATCH (c:Consumer {id: 'Consumer_1002'}), (d:Dispatcher {id: 'Dispatcher_4'}) MATCH p = shortestPath((c)-[*..15]-(d)) RETURN [n IN nodes(p) | n.id] AS pathNodes, [r IN relationships(p) | type(r)] AS pathRels, length(p) AS hops LIMIT 1
MATCH (w:WeatherCondition)-[:AFFECTS_MODEL]->(fm:ForecastModel) WHERE w.temperature < -10 RETURN DISTINCT fm.id AS model, fm.name AS name, fm.modelType AS modelType LIMIT 100
